purpose: Per CEO R282 P3: 'Start the buyer loop, but don't sell the conclusion. The buyer does not need to believe that V2 works. They need to be willing to test it. That's the first commercial milestone: Send us the package. We'll evaluate it.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXVI — buyer's technical response becomes evidence. Article XXVIII — don't sell the conclusion (5-seed result is model-only, not clinical).

the_first_commercial_milestone.definition: A real engineer at a real buyer company says: 'Send us the package. We'll evaluate it.'
the_first_commercial_milestone.what_this_is_NOT: Not a transaction. Not a sales pitch. Not a belief that V2 works.
the_first_commercial_milestone.what_this_IS: A willingness to TEST V2. The buyer's objections then become machine-readable evidence that enters the loop.

what_we_now_have_that_we_did_not_have_be.pre_registered_5seed_result: V2 materially outperforms B on 7/9 attack modes across 5 seeds. Primary endpoint PASSED all 4 pre-registered conditions. This is the first STATISTICALLY ROBUST evidence in the package.
what_we_now_have_that_we_did_not_have_be.ablation_identified_mechanism: Rate limiting is universally critical (9/9 attacks). The commercial asset is ONE mechanism, not four.
what_we_now_have_that_we_did_not_have_be.honest_weakness_disclosed: sensor_dropout is V2's weakness (V2 worse than B, 0.80x ratio). multi_failure peak 103.5 mmHg. These are disclosed, not hidden.
what_we_now_have_that_we_did_not_have_be.physical_bench_protocol: 135-run blinded protocol that can DISPROVE the simulator. Buyer can reproduce without trusting our software.

updated_buyer_message_R282.framing: We have a 5-seed statistically validated result that V2's rate-limited control outperforms existing closed-loop control under sensor noise. We also have an honest weakness: V2 is worse under sensor dropout. We want your engineering team to evaluate it — try to break it, find weaknesses we missed, tell us if the mechanism has value for your product line.
what_we_send: 5-seed primary results (90 runs, V2 vs B, 9 attacks)
Partial ablation results (seed 42, rate limiting universally critical)
Physical bench protocol (135-run blinded protocol, can disprove simulator)
updated_buyer_message_R282.what_we_ask: Run the simulator. Compare V2 to your current approach. Try to break V2 with your own attack scenarios. Tell us: does the rate-limited control mechanism add value beyond your current capability?
updated_buyer_message_R282.what_we_do_NOT_ask: We do not ask you to believe V2 works. We do not ask you to buy anything. We do not ask you to sign an NDA to see the simulator. We ask you to TEST it.

miethke_outreach_ready.rationale: Miethke has SENSOR RESERVOIR (telemetric ICP sensor in shunt reservoir). V2 is the control law that turns their monitor into a closed-loop system. The 5-seed result gives us enough evidence to support a technical evaluation conversation.
miethke_outreach_ready.the_ask: Send us the package. We'll evaluate it.
expected_outcomes: Best case: Miethke engineering team runs the simulator, confirms V2's advantage, requests bench prototype spec → technical evaluation commitment
Neutral case: Miethke says 'interesting but not our priority right now' → logged in outreach tracker, revisit after bench validation
Worst case: Miethke says 'this doesn't work because ___' → the objection enters the BUYER_FEEDBACK_INTAKE_SCHEMA and shapes V2.1
miethke_outreach_ready.all_outcomes_are_evidence: Per Article XXVI, any buyer response — positive, neutral, or negative — is the first independent commercial evidence event. It enters the loop.

success_metric_for_R283: At least 1 of 5 buyers responds with 'Send me the package; we'll evaluate it.' That is the first commercial evidence event. The buyer's technical response — whether positive or negative — becomes evidence in the loop.
